summary: Phase 3 Marketing Core OS implemented and verified locally, not yet committed: brand, audiences, goals, content pillars, campaigns, content workflow, calendar, media library, dashboard, activity; tenant-isolated, permission-checked, audited, Arabic RTL and English LTR. Awaiting human commit review.
breaking_changes: The workspace home page is now the marketing dashboard, and the shell navigation lists the Marketing Core sections the role may open.
risks: Media uploads have no per-user rate limit; each workspace is capped at 500 images of at most 10 MiB.
Images are served as uploaded (no re-encoding or EXIF stripping) under nosniff and a sandboxing CSP.
SCHEDULED is a planning state only; nothing is published automatically (no job runner until a later phase).
Missing records inside a workspace render a soft 404 (HTTP 200 with the not-found page) because workspace pages stream a loading state.
Media delete removes the stored object after the database commit; if that call fails the object is orphaned (logged, unreachable).
recommended_next_action: Review the uncommitted Phase 3 changes and approve a commit, or request changes.
